advice:
Own verdict: Test current instructions first. Bound the goal to distinguishing full-request completion from milestone readiness; update goal.md with this scope and observable must-pass criteria before execution, then change existing guidance only for a demonstrated ambiguity.
Gemini review: Agree with its three-case probe and rejection of blind edits: continuation and scoped QA already exist. Reject automatic blocked-authority “halt”: stop unauthorized steps, not independent authorized work.
Next: Run fresh-context cases: multi-slice request must continue beyond ready slice; blocked authority must report the unmet endpoint without overreach; explicit local-only request must stop locally. Require correct completion status and next action in every case. If one fails, patch concisely and rerun.
Risk: Synthetic repo probes cannot establish real-product reliability, sustained autonomy, or commercial viability; preserve unrelated edits and authority boundaries.
